sentence: This project buys a computer server and workstations to support research on Generative Artificial Intelligence and big data.
This project studies random-walks built from symmetries of a space and how they behave on spaces that come from number theoretic problems.
This project studies how nanoparticles assemble on their own during laser additive manufacturing and change the grain structure of titanium metals.
This project holds a conference where researchers share work on the genetics and genomics of legumes such as soybean and peanut.
This project builds a tool that measures a patient's pain from physiological signals and facial expressions using machine learning.
This project studies where snow and glacial algae grow on the Greenland Ice Sheet and how they make ice melt faster.
This project uses light from distant quasars to test how entangled photons behave and to time photons arriving from pulsars.
This project builds a tool that spots and explains cyber-attacks on multistage manufacturing systems using both cyber and physical signals.
This project studies how genes, chemicals in the diet and gut microbes help monarch butterflies resist a parasite.
This project builds specialized computer chips and software that run deep neural networks with less energy.
This project holds a conference on peptide materials, which combine the molecular precision of biology with the design flexibility of synthetic materials.
This project builds methods to describe and train image-based deep neural networks so their behavior is guaranteed to be appropriate.
This project builds ways to protect intelligent 3D sensing systems, such as those in autonomous vehicles, from threats.
